facts: The fixture calls storeValidate before storeEncode and before archive planning.
The committed result is bound to the rewritten immutable request/audit pair through the same actor, CoreKey and keyed idempotency digest used by mutationFromState.
Prepared, noop, failed, unknown and approved records satisfy the explicit storeValidateControl state-specific predicates; approval fields match the approve command and its result.

proof: sealedArchiveReplaceGenesisV8 edits and reseals only the genesis envelope; the intent core remains unchanged.

designAlignment.conclusion: Product classification is consistent with v8: linked-object conflict maps to subscription_archive_conflict, while strict reconstructed-v1 byte proof failure maps to subscription_archive_reconstruction_failed. A genesis-only repeated-identity mutation is a linked-object conflict before reconstruction.
